premises: Some recipient households spend part of the payment on present goods and services within six months, rather than saving it all or repaying debt.
Some of what recipients spend on present goods buys goods that would not have been bought without the payment, rather than goods that would have been bought on credit anyway (A-6).
households.source: 30% of households planned to spend it on goods and services. A 2014 energy rebate of 300 crowns per household was followed by higher card spending in the following two months.

premises: Some recipient households save part of the payment or use it to repay debt.
households.source: 30% of households planned to save most of the payment, 40% to pay bills or debts

premises: Some recipients would have borrowed in July to December 2027 for purchases they now pay with the payment.
households.source: About 35% of households report less than one month's income in liquid savings.

premises: Recipients spend enough of the payment on housing (a deposit toward a purchase, a higher rent) to raise home values.
households.source: 1,000 crowns per household, once, tax-free (assumption A-19: a deposit toward a purchase, a higher rent)

premises: Some payments are diverted by identity fraud, or made twice.
households.source: Bank details on file can be changed online with a password. False claims must be repaid, with a fine of 2,000 crowns, and may be prosecuted as fraud.

premises: Many households expect a further payment and delay purchases to wait for it.
households.source: The Finance Minister announced the payment in the budget speech on 4 March 2027 (assumption A-15: a further payment expected)

premises: Retailers can organize to press for a repeat payment, and expect a chance of success.
households.source: 1,000 crowns per household, once (assumption A-13: repeat payment pressed for)

premises: The supply of loans to Kestland is not perfectly elastic in 2027 and 2028: foreign lenders do not supply all the extra funds at the going rate.
Rates on household deposits and on card and payday credit move little in 2027 in response to the auctions; the higher rate falls mainly on business and mortgage borrowers.
bondholders.source: Up to 4.1 billion crowns, sold at auction from May to August 2027 to banks, pension funds, other private buyers and foreign buyers.

households.separate_filers.source: Reading U1-b: one payment per tax-filing unit, so an address with an adult child or a lodger who files separately receives two.

taxpayers.future.source: Repaid from general revenue in ten equal annual installments from 2028.
